widgets_values:
OFFICIAL H3 / MOTION

This is the editable graph used by the API. Save back to h3_presets/motion.json in ComfyUI's workflow folder to change future renders.

Model, attention, sampler, schedule, refinement and De-rope settings live in these nodes. No all-in-one node.

Music Suite / H3 Lab still supply prompt, size, frames, seed, references, guides and final audio. Node properties mark those request bindings.

Manual use: fill the prompt. Optional reference is muted; choose an image and unmute it. Frame-guide node is bypassed; choose its image and enable it. API requests insert their own media nodes.
